title: Rule Writer (Fraud detection)

Location: Brussels, Belgium (Hybrid)
Department: Fraud & Cyber Security
Level:Mediorto Senior

At ING, we are committed to protecting our customers and society from fraud and abuse. As a Rule Writer in our Fraud Detection team, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, andoptimizingfraud detection rules across various banking channels. You will work at the intersection of fraud prevention, IT, and data analytics, helping us stay one step ahead of fraudsters in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
